name: AVIC Aviation High-Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: AVIC Aviation High-Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise primarily engaged in the research, development, production, and sale of advanced aviation materials and specialized equipment. Its extensive product portfolio includes a diverse range of computer numerical control (CNC) machine tools, such as various milling machines (vertical, horizontal, gantry, and roll types), lathes (including inclined bed CNC models), and advanced machining centers. These sophisticated machines serve a wide array of industrial applications, spanning mold fabrication, automotive component production, wind and nuclear power generation, marine vessel construction, military and aerospace sectors, and educational purposes. Beyond core machining tools, AVIC also manufactures specialized equipment like rocker milling machines, straw briquetting machines, and biomass granulators. Additionally, the company provides design, manufacturing, and sales services for mechanical and electrical products and molds, alongside offering technical collaboration and expert consulting services. A significant part of its operations involves pioneering carbon materials manufacturing technology, targeting sectors like aviation, aerospace, and rail transportation. Furthermore, AVIC is active in the medical field, developing, producing, and distributing orthopedic implants, including artificial hips, knees, spines, and other surgical devices. It also specializes in advanced composite materials, crucial for civil aviation, automotive manufacturing, rail transport, as well as petroleum, electricity, and new energy industries. Its global footprint extends through product exports to various international markets, such as the United States, Brazil, Southeast Asia, India, the Middle East, and Africa. Established in 1988, the company is headquartered in Nantong, China. It operated as Tontec Technology Investment Group Co., Ltd. until May 2016, when it adopted its current name.
